name: Shinkuu, Shoujo Namida wo Koboseru ka
storyline:
June. A girl threw herself from the school rooftop.
This is a story about that girl, told from two perspectives.

[Shimabara's Perspective]
As class president, I witnessed my classmate, Shimahara Machiko, jump to her death.
Standing on the rooftop I looked up at was a chillingly indifferent girl, Kusamizu Yuusui.
"She fell. Of her own will."
As I drew closer to uncover the truth, I touched the unfathomable darkness within her—
and gradually, my own mind began to be eroded...

[Kusamizu's Perspective]
Living out my lonely days, I met the carefree girl Shimahara Machiko at a quiet, hideaway café.
Unable to leave her alone—hiding the scars of bullying behind a cheerful facade—a strange cohabitation began.
Warm stew, baths shared between the two of us, peaceful moments.
But the cruel countdown was steadily advancing...

When the present and the past — two perspectives — intersect, the world is filled with a vacuum.
summary:
In June, a girl throws herself from her school rooftop. As class president, Shimabara witnessed her death and becomes determined to uncover the truth behind it. Her investigation leads her to Kusamizu Yuusui, a mysterious girl hiding a dark and troubled past.

But through another perspective, we discover Yuusui’s connection to the girl who died: a fragile bond shaped by loneliness, bullying, and fleeting moments of warmth. As past and present slowly collide, the truth behind the tragedy begins to emerge.
